comparison.objective: Plant a second strawberry row staggered relative to a machine-set row; candidate removes insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated plant placement using row-relative spacing versus mandrel alignment, bimanual hammering and fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: Second-row plants form the required staggered pattern; detailed tolerances are absent. Candidate requires four safe fractures and complete containment.
comparison.reason: Patterned planting does not exercise controlled fracture or assembly-component protection.
